title: MCP OAuth test note
body: This is a **test post** published through the new MCP + OAuth pipeline, not the old Custom GPT Action. If you're reading this on the live site, the whole chain worked end to end - Claude connector, OAuth token, the daily publish cron, and the [dashboard](https://content.misterautomate.com) that manages it all.

list: Real headings, rendered as actual HTML headings, not literal `##` text
A genuine bullet list, not a paragraph with dashes in it
**Bold** text and a working [link back to the dashboard](https://content.misterautomate.com)

body: The site's renderer is intentionally narrow: only `**bold**` and `[text](https://url)` links render inside a paragraph. Headings and lists only work if they arrive as structured blocks rather than Markdown syntax - which is exactly what the publish step now converts this note's body into before it reaches GitHub.
Plain paragraphs like this one, with no special markup at all, just render as an ordinary line of text.
